items.summary: Risk disposition: blocked for public exposure, security-sensitive releases, unsupported claims, monetization expansion, and external outreach. Conditional for ordinary reversible growth only when it adds no credentials, permissions, dependencies, new data collection, or cross-site behavior and preserves consent, disclosures, provenance, claims, copyright/trademark, affiliate, platform-policy, and age-sensitive boundaries. Evidence: compliance baseline is technical only with 37 pass, 16 fail, and 6 unknown; analytics quality is yellow; operations and security sweeps are unavailable; revenue is $4.92 aggregate and unattributed for 2026-09-21. Exact decision: maintain containment-only execution, authorize no spend or new telemetry, keep public exposure and security-sensitive releases blocked, and continue only existing evidence, measurement, repair-or-close, finance reconciliation, launch-readiness, and parked-site readiness work. This is risk triage, not legal advice or certification.

SearchWoot tracking remains active: 0 of 4 tasks are closed and 4 remain open. Progress evidenced: official API, terms, and support review; partial repository/configuration data-flow evidence; privacy and cookie-policy artifacts; and draft site terms. No task is closed because direct evidence remains missing. Keep SearchWoot private, preview-only, and blocked for public beta, full launch, alert expansion, affiliate use, and advertising. Keep rights outreach unsent pending human-counsel review and owner authorization. Next evidence action: attach one consolidated read-only bundle covering field-level rights, deployed data flow, identifiers, retention, deletion, correction, access, notification consent, unsubscribe behavior, GA4 configuration and retention, log fields, vendors, incident/request procedures, accuracy/freshness controls, and rollback evidence.

Keep complicated.work, deadlymaracas.com, and driveford.net parked, private, preview-only, and unlaunched. No publish, deployment, DNS change, analytics configuration, monetization, spending, dependency addition, or queue entry is cleared. Continue only the existing readiness packets. Next evidence action: attach dated ownership, preview/build, compliance, security, measurement-boundary, rollback, and explicit-blocker evidence for each property by the existing deadline.

Woot API deal and price-history data: blocked. Missing written permission or API agreement plus field-level limits for storage, derivatives, caching, display, alerts, attribution, freshness, correction, takedown, trademarks, images, affiliate use, and advertising. Smallest next action: complete the internal counsel packet and obtain human-counsel review. User alert rules and sync results: evidence_needed. Missing data inventory, identifiers, retention, deletion, correction, access, processor terms, notification consent, and unsubscribe behavior. Smallest next action: produce a read-only deployed/repository data-flow and retention table. GA4 analytics: evidence_needed. The stated consent-gated measurement use is conditionally supportable, but deployed consent and withdrawal behavior, GA4 property/data-sharing settings, retention settings, and jurisdictional treatment are missing. Smallest next action: capture consent and GA4 configuration evidence without enabling tracking, remarketing, or advertising. Operational logs and Cloudflare hosting data: evidence_needed. Operational use is conditionally supportable, but log fields, retention/access controls, vendor coverage, incident handling, subpoena process, and data-subject-request procedures are missing. Smallest next action: produce a read-only log, vendor, incident, and request inventory. No secondary disclosure or monetization is cleared.

Continue only the existing read-only security evidence matrix using authorized metadata and retained artifacts. Record dated evidence or explicit unknowns for access boundaries, secrets, isolation, release controls, dependencies, TLS, data exposure, monitoring, incident readiness, and disclosure readiness. Keep public exposure and security-sensitive releases blocked; do not access credentials or private containers, modify permissions or configuration, add dependencies, deploy, requeue, or conduct outreach.
